request.description:
Login dengan username & password.

**✅ Features:**
- Password SHA1 hashed
- Log ke `logger.log_login`
- Log JWT ke `logger.log_jwt`
- Generate access token (15 min)
- Generate refresh token (7 days)
- Save token metadata to Redis

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "user": {
      "id": "8A9B55FC...",
      "username": "DWI.RETNO21",
      "name": "DWI RETNO SEPTIANA",
      "email": "...",
      "role": "user"
    },
    "tokens": {
      "access_token": "eyJ0eXAi...",
      "token_type": "Bearer",
      "expires_in": 900
    }
  }
}
```

Refresh access token menggunakan refresh token.

**⏰ Kapan digunakan:**
- Access token expired (15 minutes)
- Response 401 Unauthorized

**✅ Features:**
- Validate refresh token dari database
- Check if revoked
- Generate new access token
- Log ke `logger.log_jwt`
- Update Redis cache

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "access_token": "eyJ0eXAi...",
    "token_type": "Bearer",
    "expires_in": 900
  }
}
```

exec: console.log('✅ Tokens cleared from collection variables');

request.description:
Logout dari current device.

**✅ Features:**
- Revoke refresh token
- Expire access token
- Update `logger.log_login` (set waktu_logout)
- **Invalidate user cache (NEW!)** ← Redis cache cleared
- Clear session

**Auth:** Bearer Token required

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Logout successful"
}
```

**🚀 Redis Cache Cleared:**
- `auth:user:session:{userId}`
- `auth:user:tokens:{userId}`
- `auth:jwt:log:{userId}`

exec: console.log('✅ Logged out from all devices');

request.description:
Logout dari SEMUA devices.

**✅ Features:**
- Revoke ALL refresh tokens for user
- Expire ALL access tokens
- Update ALL login sessions
- **Invalidate all user caches (NEW!)** ← All Redis caches cleared

**⚠️ Use case:**
- Suspected account breach
- Change password
- Force re-authentication

**Auth:** Bearer Token required

Get all active sessions/tokens for current user.

**🚀 NEW: Redis Cache Enabled!**
- First request: Query database (~180ms)
- Subsequent requests: From Redis (~15ms) ← **90% FASTER!**
- Cache TTL: 15 minutes
- Auto-invalidate on logout/revoke

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "sessions": [
      {
        "session_id": "uuid",
        "device_name": "postman",
        "ip_address": "127.0.0.1",
        "browser": "PostmanRuntime",
        "os": "Unknown",
        "created_at": "2025-10-12 00:45:12",
        "is_active": true
      }
    ],
    "active_tokens": 12,
    "total_sessions": 5,
    "cached": true  ← Shows if data from cache
  }
}
```

**Performance:**
- Cache MISS (first request): ~180ms
- Cache HIT (subsequent): ~15ms
- **90% faster with cache!**

Get info tentang current access token.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "jti": "uuid",
    "type": "access",
    "user_id": "uuid",
    "issued_at": "2025-10-12 00:45:12",
    "expires_at": "2025-10-12 01:00:12",
    "time_remaining": "854 seconds",
    "ip_address": "127.0.0.1",
    "url": "/api/v1/auth/login",
    "is_expired": false
  }
}
```

Revoke specific refresh token by JTI.

**Use case:**
- Revoke token dari device tertentu
- User melihat login mencurigakan di /sessions

**Body:**
```json
{
  "token_id": "uuid-of-refresh-token-jti"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Token revoked successfully"
}
```

Check Redis connection status.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "status": "healthy",
  "message": "Redis is connected"
}
```

**Status Codes:**
- 200: Redis healthy
- 503: Redis unavailable

Get Redis cache statistics.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "cache_keys": {
      "user_sessions": 25,
      "user_tokens": 25,
      "jwt_logs": 15,
      "refresh_tokens": 120,
      "token_meta": 50,
      "blacklist": 2,
      "memory_used": "3.2M"
    },
    "total_keys": 237,
    "memory": "3.2M",
    "redis_status": "connected"
  }
}
```

**Use For:**
- Monitoring cache usage
- Checking memory consumption
- Debugging cache issues

**⚠️ DANGER:** Clear ALL auth-related caches.

**Use Cases:**
- Development/testing
- After database migration
- Debugging cache issues

**⚠️ Production Warning:**
- This will cause cache misses for ALL users
- Next requests will be slower (rebuild from DB)
- Use with caution!

**Required Body:**
```json
{
  "confirm": "yes"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "All auth caches cleared successfully",
  "note": "Next requests will rebuild cache from database"
}
```

Invalidate cache for specific user.

**Use Cases:**
- User reported stale data
- After manual database update
- Testing cache behavior

**Body:**
```json
{
  "user_id": "8A9B55FC-E142-4DCE-A736-0000356DE151"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Cache invalidated for user {user_id}"
}
```

**Caches Cleared:**
- `auth:user:session:{userId}`
- `auth:user:tokens:{userId}`
- `auth:jwt:log:{userId}`
